heading: Summer Classes: Can I take C.S. classes in the summer?
title: Summer Classes
summary: CS summer courses require prior written permission from the CS department chair; they are not normally permitted. Required MAT courses taken in summer need approval of the specific course and institution by the math department.

heading: A.P. in C.S. Exemption: Can I be exempted from taking Intro to C.S. (COM 1300) if I took the A.P. in C.S. exam?
title: A.P. in C.S. Exemption
summary: The CS department does not exempt COM 1300 based on the AP Computer Science exam.

heading: A.I. track and Math Minor: If I complete the B.S. A.I. track, do I have to take any additional classes to earn a math minor?
title: A.I. track and Math Minor
summary: The department states that completing the BS in CS AI track also earns the mathematics minor without additional classes. This is a published overlap, not a separate complete mathematics-minor audit.
